skills.degradedBehavior: Delivery review retains its declared bound; plan review is unbounded and may end by operator decision.
Decomposition remains complete and reports the undecomposed candidates plus every omitted mutation when the host-native tracker capability is unavailable.
Optional tracking remains optional; declared product recovery must reconcile saved context and unresolved actions before evidence reuse.

Without a configuration the views are not declared and the core workflow's built-in pages remain; a view that cannot read a run, a report or a snapshot shows it as unavailable rather than failing the render. Recovered landing times use source occurrence, while the activity feed retains observation time. Unknown phase times remain unavailable; configured forge templates recognize validated cross-repository pull requests with compact labels and retained repository identity. Native review observations retain actual reports without a run; missing or candidate-mismatched artifacts stay unavailable and carry no admission authority. Originating closure explanations remain available through a collapsed keyboard-accessible disclosure, with settlement summaries visible. Without a plan.json the line map is unchanged; one that can't be read adds only the plan chapter with a flag naming its key path. A plan without planReview or a blocking approval draws exactly as before. A record without a lead check selection draws the checking panel as before. Before hand-off a planned story's round cards and notes come from the capture of its latest journaled round; a planned story with no round yet says when its rounds will appear. Without the supervisor's needs-you.json the Now chapter has no Needs you box; a list from a stopped supervisor, one a pass overdue, or one that can't be read is shown as unavailable, never stale.
Execution remains complete and reports every omitted tracking mutation when the host-native tracker capability is unavailable.

Optional tracking and sensors may be absent; declared product gates and recovery remain authoritative and cannot be replaced with executor-invented evidence. Unsupported v2 reporting remains explicit; retain selected output without changing delivery authority. Terminal handoffs retain the bound review release identity and any release installed mid-review. Shared sensor resources follow the declared allocation; explicit caller scope remains authoritative for stale test pins.

Core delivery remains complete and reports omitted optional tracking when the host-native Linear capability is unavailable. schemaVersion identifies the properties document; operational properties remain read-only inputs.

Native subagent dispatch and aggregation remain available without Python helpers; unavailable lenses remain explicit acquisition states. Unsupported v2 reporting remains explicit; retain selected output without changing delivery authority. Every host-convention lens uses a separate verified candidate checkout; unavailable isolation remains explicit. Base-move replay identity compares delivered path and line bytes, independent of shifted hunk positions or context.

Without a host that can start and message sessions no lane starts: the lead records the blocker and brings it to the operator, who may choose to deliver the tickets one at a time through $execute-work. Optional tracking may be absent; the delivery state and journal remain authoritative for where the epic stands. Recovered merges preserve source occurrence separately from observation; unavailable source times remain unknown. Native review observations retain actual reports without a run; missing or candidate-mismatched artifacts stay unavailable and carry no admission authority. Ready and merge hooks receive an exact runner-derived single or batch check mode; it carries no admission authority. Without selection.lead in the binding, or without a lead selection for the candidate's reviewed head, the provider selects its checks as before. Without bases in the binding, the runner serves its base.ref alone. Before hand-off a planned story has no head, so its observation is bound to the capture of its latest journaled round, and a later uncaptured round leaves it unavailable. Planned work whose ticket no tracker snapshot has shown started is never reported back in the tracker's backlog.

Planning remains complete without optional tracking and reports unavailable optional sensors without replacing repository authority. Nonconverging plan review is not guaranteed to terminate without an operator decision; parallel resources and extension test pins are planned.

Unavailable reviewer evidence remains a failed acquisition; unavailable host cost is explicitly unreported. Unsupported v2 reporting remains explicit; retain selected output without changing delivery authority. Unbounded plan-review rounds are outside the delivery bound and reducer.

POSIX hosts only: on Windows the tool exits with a message saying so. Without a forge adapter the lead pushes and opens change requests; without ffmpeg and ffprobe video evidence is unavailable; without Node at the runtime's nodeMinimum doctor reports it and lead-init refuses; without in-app adapters no in-app checks are declared. A delivery file without criteria writes no plan, and the plan chapter stays off. A delivery without planReview lenses has no plan review, and lead-init freezes its plan as before. Without bases in the binding, a delivery lands only on its base.ref, and lead-setup's --base stays optional. Without the lead's checkout, view --archive serves an archived copy of the record with the built-in page. Without a tracker adapter, or with tracker.updates set to manual, the lead posts tracker updates by hand; a jira or linear tracker snapshot, or tracker.adapter, posts them through run-delivery's tracker publisher, and a binding whose publisher has a kind and no argv is refused, naming that fix. Without a supervisor (lead-init --no-supervisor, RUN_DELIVERY_SUPERVISOR=off, or one that stopped), the lead's commands do each duty by hand and lead-run --resume starts it again; without the readyPullRequests grant a merge step that refuses drafts gets drafts, and lead-init refuses that. Without a merge script of its own, a binding merges through a shipped forge adapter's merge --source, which merges a branch's one open pull request only at the checked head and refuses anything else. Without tracker.transitions.reviewWhen the lane commands make no review move and print it for the lane instead. The supervisor writes each pass's Needs you list into the record for the line map, and marks it not running when it stops. Without the generation's host hooks installed, or with a hook set off, no lead's stop is held and no session is oriented: the lead-wait each lead command prints, the status line and Needs you keep the lead's wake.
